title: West Bengal Swasthya Sathi – family health cover Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: West Bengal government health assurance scheme providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization support to eligible families.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows current West Bengal Swasthya Sathi beneficiary rules and exclusions.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under West Bengal Swasthya Sathi – family health cover.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
